method.timing: Serial uninstrumented run(N) or capturePhysical calls only, including API batch copying. Module generation/compilation, construction, subscription, inputs, hashing, snapshots and comparison are outside timers.
method.order: One discarded warmup per case/variant, fresh instances, then rotate three variants and reverse on odd trials. No parallel performance run, affinity, GC control or V8 flags.
method.attribution: baseline=original runtime; candidate-full=new independent PCM ring with default full trace/legacy audio discard; candidate-audio=same new runtime with explicit host mask0. One unchanged compiler and current host wrapper for all variants.
method.parity: Exact full chip/CPU state and diagnostics, SRAM/Flash/EEPROM/IRQ, PCM bytes and default full-trace tail at every checkpoint. Audio-only host history is explicitly omitted; before audio starts, queued initialization history is preserved. No deadline or clock-state normalization.
method.limits: Node coupled CPU/peripheral/pin/PCM execution, no DSP or browser-latency guarantee. Host scheduling, GC and tiering affect timings. Profile samples are not used to assign exclusive subsystem times.
